description.en: Your memory as a folder of markdown files: AtAt writes what you do into it, and brings the relevant parts back. Local search comes from qmd, which you run yourself.
description.zh-hans: 记忆就是一个 markdown 目录：AtAt 把你的交互写进去，需要时再拿回来。检索交给你自己跑的 qmd，全程本地。

description.en: Where memories you keep on purpose live. Notes land in inbox/, captured images in assets/. Put it in iCloud Drive to have your phone write into the same inbox/.
description.zh-hans: 你主动收藏的记忆放在这里：笔记写进 inbox/，截图写进 assets/。选 iCloud 里的目录，手机上的快捷指令就能往同一个 inbox/ 里写。

description.en: Where AtAt writes down what you did, one note per interaction. High volume, so a local folder is usually the right choice. Leave it unset and nothing is recorded.
description.zh-hans: AtAt 自动记录交互的地方，一次交互一篇。量大，一般选本地目录就好。不设置就不会记录。

description.en: The port qmd's local server listens on (qmd mcp --http --port). Recall is skipped silently when nothing answers there.
description.zh-hans: qmd 本地服务监听的端口（qmd mcp --http --port）。端口上没人应答时，召回会静默跳过。

description.en: How many memories may be attached to one request. Each one arrives as a pill you can delete before sending.
description.zh-hans: 一次请求最多附带几条记忆。每条都是一个可以在发送前删掉的 pill。

description.en: Writes one markdown note per interaction — your request, the answer and a summary of the attached context — into the trajectory folder.
description.zh-hans: 每次交互往轨迹目录写一篇 markdown：你的请求、回答，以及附带 context 的概要。
